technologyProfile.capabilities: The combined assemblies recover water from multiple waste streams on the space station.
technologyProfile.limitations: The demonstration used the station air and water loops. It does not establish how a stand-alone Mars habitat would perform.

title: ISS Water Recovery System
summary: The combined assemblies recover water from multiple waste streams on the space station.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Carrying fresh water for every use makes a crew dependent on resupply.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: The urine processor distils wastewater. A brine processor draws more water from the residue into humid air; the station collects condensate and the water processor treats it.

claims.text: The urine processor distils wastewater. A brine processor draws more water from the residue into humid air; the station collects condensate and the water processor treats it.
